mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 68 degrees near Harriet Park, a waning crescent moon, an overnight low of 64, and no rain predicted.

The City of Verona manages engineering services through AECOM Incorporated, with detailed progress reports submitted to the City Council at every meeting to ensure full transparency on municipal projects.

Tomorrow is a big day for local fun with the Dane County Farmers Market at the Square, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, don't miss the Girls Try Hockey event this Saturday at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly police report, on July 31 at 12:35 AM, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
Today's featured flavor is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to the Andes Mint Avalanche tomorrow, with doors opening at 10 AM.
